children: FTSE UK Index Series - Quarterly Fast Entry Level - September 2026
FTSE Russell announces that in accordance with rule 8.4, the following FTSE 100 and FTSE 250 Fast Entry levels are effective immediately.

For a security to be considered for fast entry to the FTSE 100, its full market capitalisation (i.e. before the application of any investability weighting) must be equal to or greater than GBP 4.5bn and its investable market capitalisation must be

For a security to be considered for fast entry to the FTSE 250, its full market capitalisation (i.e. before the application of any investability weighting) must be equal to or greater than GBP 1.18bn and its investable market capitalisation must be GBP 1bn or above.
